en.text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

zhSimplified.text: 利玛利的儿子比加十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基。

zhTraditional.text: 利瑪利的兒子比加十七年，猶大王約坦的兒子亞哈斯登基。

en.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.

zhSimplified.text: 他登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大卫行耶和华—他 神眼中看为正的事，

zhTraditional.text: 他登基的時候年二十歲，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大衛行耶和華－他上帝眼中看為正的事，

en.text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 却效法以色列诸王所行的，又照着耶和华从以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的儿子经火，

zhTraditional.text: 卻效法以色列諸王所行的，又照着耶和華從以色列人面前趕出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的兒子經火，

en.text: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

zhSimplified.text: 并在邱坛上、山冈上、各青翠树下献祭烧香。

zhTraditional.text: 並在邱壇上、山岡上、各青翠樹下獻祭燒香。

en.text: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰王利汛和以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，围困亚哈斯，却不能胜他。

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭王利汛和以色列王利瑪利的兒子比加上來攻打耶路撒冷，圍困亞哈斯，卻不能勝他。

en.text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 当时亚兰王利汛收回以拉他归与亚兰，将犹大人从以拉他赶出去。亚兰人就来到以拉他，住在那里，直到今日。

zhTraditional.text: 當時亞蘭王利汛收回以拉他歸與亞蘭，將猶大人從以拉他趕出去。亞蘭人就來到以拉他，住在那裏，直到今日。

en.text: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯差遣使者去见亚述王提革拉·毗列色，说：「我是你的仆人、你的儿子。现在亚兰王和以色列王攻击我，求你来救我脱离他们的手。」

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯差遣使者去見亞述王提革拉‧毗列色，說：「我是你的僕人、你的兒子。現在亞蘭王和以色列王攻擊我，求你來救我脫離他們的手。」

en.text: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯将耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的金银都送给亚述王为礼物。

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯將耶和華殿裏和王宮府庫裏所有的金銀都送給亞述王為禮物。

en.text: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

zhSimplified.text: 亚述王应允了他，就上去攻打大马士革，将城攻取，杀了利汛，把居民掳到吉珥。

zhTraditional.text: 亞述王應允了他，就上去攻打大馬士革，將城攻取，殺了利汛，把居民擄到吉珥。

en.text: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯王上大马士革去迎接亚述王提革拉·毗列色，在大马士革看见一座坛，就照坛的规模样式作法画了图样，送到祭司乌利亚那里。

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯王上大馬士革去迎接亞述王提革拉‧毗列色，在大馬士革看見一座壇，就照壇的規模樣式作法畫了圖樣，送到祭司烏利亞那裏。

en.text: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司乌利亚照着亚哈斯王从大马士革送来的图样，在亚哈斯王没有从大马士革回来之先，建筑一座坛。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司烏利亞照着亞哈斯王從大馬士革送來的圖樣，在亞哈斯王沒有從大馬士革回來之先，建築一座壇。

en.text: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

zhSimplified.text: 王从大马士革回来看见坛，就近前来，在坛上献祭；

zhTraditional.text: 王從大馬士革回來看見壇，就近前來，在壇上獻祭；

en.text: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 烧燔祭、素祭、浇奠祭，将平安祭牲的血洒在坛上，

zhTraditional.text: 燒燔祭、素祭、澆奠祭，將平安祭牲的血灑在壇上，

en.text: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

zhSimplified.text: 又将耶和华面前的铜坛从耶和华殿和新坛的中间搬到新坛的北边。

zhTraditional.text: 又將耶和華面前的銅壇從耶和華殿和新壇的中間搬到新壇的北邊。

en.text: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯王吩咐祭司乌利亚说：「早晨的燔祭、晚上的素祭，王的燔祭、素祭，国内众民的燔祭、素祭、奠祭都要烧在大坛上。燔祭牲和平安祭牲的血也要洒在这坛上，只是铜坛我要用以求问耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯王吩咐祭司烏利亞說：「早晨的燔祭、晚上的素祭，王的燔祭、素祭，國內眾民的燔祭、素祭、奠祭都要燒在大壇上。燔祭牲和平安祭牲的血也要灑在這壇上，只是銅壇我要用以求問耶和華。」

en.text: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司乌利亚就照着亚哈斯王所吩咐的行了。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司烏利亞就照着亞哈斯王所吩咐的行了。

en.text: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯王打掉盆座四面镶着的心子，把盆从座上挪下来，又将铜海从驮海的铜牛上搬下来，放在铺石地；

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯王打掉盆座四面鑲着的心子，把盆從座上挪下來，又將銅海從馱海的銅牛上搬下來，放在鋪石地；

en.text: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to the LORD’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

zhSimplified.text: 又因亚述王的缘故，将耶和华殿为安息日所盖的廊子和王从外入殿的廊子挪移，围绕耶和华的殿。

zhTraditional.text: 又因亞述王的緣故，將耶和華殿為安息日所蓋的廊子和王從外入殿的廊子挪移，圍繞耶和華的殿。

en.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯其餘所行的事都寫在猶大列王記上。

en.text: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子希西家接续他作王。

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯與他列祖同睡，葬在大衛城他列祖的墳地裏。他兒子希西家接續他作王。
